scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-api && npm run build --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-client
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @crown-and-coin/shared && npm run build --workspace @crown-and-coin/platform
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n client,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-client" "npm run start:dev --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @crown-and-coin/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @crown-and-coin/platform && npm run typecheck --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-api && npm run typecheck --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-client
scripts.start: concurrently -n client,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-client" "npm run start:prod --workspace @crown-and-coin/game-api"
